Microsoft.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
Microsoft.titleEn: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
Microsoft.titleKo: NVIDIA와 Microsoft, Azure에서 Windows PC로 가속 컴퓨팅 확장
Microsoft.summary:
In MLPerf Inference v6.1 , Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65.
Alongside expanding customer access to NVIDIA technologies, Microsoft is using NVIDIA software and accelerated computing in its own AI development and services.
NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs.
summaryLinesEn: In MLPerf Inference v6.1 , Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65.

Microsoft는 NVIDIA 기술에 대한 고객 액세스를 확대하는 동시에 자체 AI 개발 및 서비스에 NVIDIA 소프트웨어와 가속 컴퓨팅을 사용하고 있음
NVIDIA와 Microsoft는 조직이 Azure의 차세대 인프라부터 산업용 시스템 및 Windows PC에 이르기까지 지능형 애플리케이션을 구축, 사용자 지정 및 배포할 수 있도록 풀 스택 협업을 확장하고 있음

Microsoft.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
Microsoft.titleKo: Microsoft와 업계 전반의 조직은 AI 모델 및 에이전트에 대한 기업의 신뢰를 강화하기 위해 AI 투명성 이니셔티브(AI Transparency Initiative)를 시작함
Microsoft.summary:
Follow the news from Microsoft Ignite, where Microsoft and industry leaders will share insights on how organizations can manage AI models and agents with confidence.
We’re proud to work with Microsoft on the AI Transparency Initiative to help establish open, industrywide standards that give organizations the visibility and control they need to deploy AI responsibly at scale.”
At Microsoft Ignite on Tuesday, Microsoft Chairman and CEO Satya Nadella announced the next phase of Microsoft’s commitment to making AI safer: the AI Transparency Initiative, a collaborative effort with customers and partners to establish a common, open approach to security and governance across models and providers.
summaryLinesEn: Follow the news from Microsoft Ignite, where Microsoft and industry leaders will share insights on how organizations can manage AI models and agents with confidence.

NVIDIA.titleEn: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
NVIDIA.titleKo: 과학이 에이전트 시대로 접어들면서 Ian Buck이 SC26에서 NVIDIA의 한 주를 시작함
NVIDIA.summary:
Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens.
In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing .
Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold.

Apple.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple, AI 에이전트의 장난을 방지하기 위해 새로운 디스크 제어 기능 추가 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
The issue rose to prominence in September, when Inc. columnist Jason Aten noticed that Meta's Muse Mac app was able to access his messages even though he thought he had denied that permission.
In its latest macOS beta, Apple introduced controls to ensure that users will need to take "very explicit" actions to grant apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini "this extraordinary level of [full disk] access."
As screen grabs from X user @madeby_ldt show, Apple's Full Disk Access setting now requires explicit permissions to be granted from a scary-looking pop-up screen.

Google DeepMind.summary:
The claim seems to dismiss Google's decades of operation before it even launched Gemini and other public-facing AI tools.

"Cutting off access to Search for schools that don't wish to use AI will not help persuade our users, and will more likely result in them shutting out Google products altogether."

Google DeepMind.summary:
Ad According to Artificial Analysis, per-task costs for Neon at xhigh come in at $6.44, roughly 17 percent below Carbon's undiscounted figure of $7.76.
Ad The Cost Advantage Comes from List Price, Not Token Efficiency Through Google AI Studio and Gemini for Business , one million input tokens costs three dollars (or $0.15 when cached) and one million output tokens costs fifteen dollars.

“What we’re seeing, for example, with computer-aided engineering, is that you can actually identify ahead of time which are non-essential parameters and you don’t run the simulation, thereby reducing the total simulation time,” she said.

Google DeepMind.summary:
To construct it, the Chrome team gathered armies of website and web app development agents guided by a purpose-built AI harness to quickly create realistic web services and data flows—down to details like entering promo codes on a shopping site or populating social media pages.
As the Google Chrome team has worked to develop AI browsing features using the company's Gemini models , they realized they need to go the extra mile to keep things from going haywire.
“Web-use” agents need to be familiar with the open internet, how to navigate real websites and platforms, and how to be hardened against web attacks.

“Web-use” agents need to be familiar with the open internet, how to navigate real websites and platforms, and how to be hardened against web attacks.
summaryLinesKo: 이를 구축하기 위해 Chrome 팀은 쇼핑 사이트에 프로모션 코드를 입력하거나 소셜 미디어 페이지를 채우는 것과 같은 세부 사항에 이르기까지 현실적인 웹 서비스와 데이터 흐름을 신속하게 생성하기 위해 특수 제작된 AI 하네스의 안내에 따라 웹사이트 및 웹 앱 개발 에이전트 군대를 모았음
Google Chrome 팀은 회사의 Gemini 모델을 사용하여 AI 탐색 기능을 개발하면서 문제가 발생하지 않도록 하려면 추가 노력이 필요하다는 것을 깨달았음
"웹 사용" 에이전트는 개방형 인터넷, 실제 웹사이트와 플랫폼을 탐색하는 방법, 웹 공격에 대비하는 방법에 익숙해야 함

Amazon.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon SageMaker 추론 · 2026년 출시 검토, 2부 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Teams want to know which configuration the model should run on now that traffic is real, how to fit more models onto GPUs they already pay for, what to do when the next model is too large for one machine, why requests wait in one Region while GPUs sit idle in another, and why latency rose when nobody changed anything.
Inference recommendations launched in April as an API.
In the spring, they launched a customer support assistant on a 70B-parameter model behind a single SageMaker AI endpoint, using the launches from part 1.

Amazon.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: SageMaker AI 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의에 대한 전체 미세 조정(FFT) | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .
summaryLinesEn: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .
summaryLinesKo: SageMaker AI의 서버리스 모델 사용자 지정을 통해 데이터 과학자와 기계 학습(ML) 엔지니어는 인프라 또는 GPU 용량 계획을 관리하지 않고도 모델 미세 조정에 집중할 수 있음
LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 미세 조정(PEFT) 방법은 LLM 매개변수의 작은 하위 집합만 업데이트하여 GPU 용량 요구 사항을 줄이는 다운스트림 작업에 대한 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 실용적인 솔루션으로 등장함
그림 4: MLflow에서 훈련 지표를 추적하는 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의 작업 전체 미세 조정에서 LoRA로 전환하려면 TrainingType.FULL을 TrainingType.LORA로 설정하는 한 가지 변경만 필요함

Amazon.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon EKS에서 NVIDIA Run:ai GPU 분할 사용 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Two Pods each requesting nvidia.com/gpu: 1 cannot run concurrently on that node, even when their combined GPU-memory demand fits.
Its GPU Fractioning Operator can help several teams share one or two GPUs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) .
We validated this walkthrough on October 22, 2026, using NVIDIA driver 615.71.10.
summaryLinesEn: Two Pods each requesting nvidia.com/gpu: 1 cannot run concurrently on that node, even when their combined GPU-memory demand fits.

summaryLinesKo: 각각 nvidia.com/gpu: 1을 요청하는 두 개의 포드는 결합된 GPU 메모리 수요가 충족되더라도 해당 노드에서 동시에 실행될 수 없음
GPU Fractioning Operator는 여러 팀이 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service(Amazon EKS)에서 하나 또는 두 개의 GPU를 공유하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있음
우리는 NVIDIA 드라이버 615.71.10을 사용하여 2026년 10월 22일에 이 연습을 검증함

Amazon.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod의 향상된 인프라 관찰 기능 소개 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Enhanced observability collects telemetry at two levels: Default metrics (enabled automatically) cover cluster health, CPU/disk/OS-level usage, GPU utilization and temperature, and per-job resource utilization.
Today, we are announcing enhanced observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, a new capability that helps you diagnose GPU training issues faster.
Figure 1: Creating a HyperPod cluster on Amazon EKS with Custom setup In the Custom setup workflow, expand the HyperPod observability section: Enable HyperPod Observability is checked by default.

오늘 우리는 GPU 교육 문제를 더 빠르게 진단하는 데 도움이 되는 새로운 기능인 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod의 향상된 관찰 가능성을 발표함

Amazon.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1이 이제 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart에 있습니다 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Dialog-RSN-1 shows up in the SageMaker JumpStart catalog with overview and sample notebooks in one place, so your team can understand the model before spending a dollar on infrastructure.
Because the model reasons directly over the caller’s audio, it picks up tone, hesitation, and timing, the signals a plain transcript loses, and decides for itself the right moment to respond.
From the same model card you choose Deploy, and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart stands up a real-time inference endpoint with a pre-configured serving stack.

Amazon.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Skyflow 및 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway로 에이전트 도구 호출 보호 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
The Skyflow interceptor de-identifies data before it reaches a tool, restores it before the agent reads the result, and replaces documents with clean copies before the agent opens them.
The controls need to sit where every tool call passes, so authorization, content safety, and data protection apply the same way to every agent and tool.
In this post, we show how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call, and out of the model context those tools feed.

모든 도구 호출이 통과하는 위치에 제어 기능이 있어야 하므로 승인, 콘텐츠 안전, 데이터 보호가 모든 에이전트와 도구에 동일한 방식으로 적용됨

Amazon.title: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon SageMaker AI |의 지역 간 추론 라우팅을 통해 지역 용량 부족에도 불구하고 추론을 계속 실행하세요 · 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Serving a model from more than one AWS Region is a well-established pattern for highly available inference: when one Region runs short of GPU capacity, requests move to another.
To use that capacity, your application must detect a struggling endpoint and switch Regions, decide which errors are safe to retry without running the model twice, move traffic back after recovery without flapping, and manage access to endpoints in other accounts.
When autoscaling can’t add instances of the type your endpoint needs, requests throttle and time out, even when the same model has spare capacity in another Region.

해당 용량을 사용하려면 애플리케이션이 문제가 있는 엔드포인트를 감지하고 리전을 전환하고, 모델을 두 번 실행하지 않고 재시도해도 안전한 오류를 결정하고, 복구 후 플래핑 없이 트래픽을 다시 이동하고, 다른 계정의 엔드포인트에 대한 액세스를 관리해야 함
Auto Scaling이 엔드포인트에 필요한 유형의 인스턴스를 추가할 수 없는 경우 동일한 모델이 다른 지역에 여유 용량이 있는 경우에도 제한 및 시간 초과를 요청함

Anthropic.summary:
After closing the largest initial public offering in history on Wednesday, Anthropic has about $200 billion in the bank, more than every tech giant besides Alphabet.
For some time, OpenAI was expected to go public first, but executive departures , shifting priorities , and legal troubles have introduced roadblocks.
Because of how Anthropic must account for compensating employees with stock, it’s still wildly unprofitable—over $104 billion in losses this year through September.

But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.

These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

Anthropic.title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
Anthropic.titleEn: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
Anthropic.summary:
Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.
Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.
While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

Anthropic.summary:
Takeaway: Affective conversations are a small but meaningful slice of Claude usage (2.9%), with most people primarily using AI for work tasks and content creation.
Takeaway: People tend to shift towards slightly more positive emotional expressions while talking to Claude.
Less than 10% of coaching or counseling conversations involve Claude resisting user requests, and when it does, it's typically for safety reasons (for example, refusing to provide dangerous weight loss advice or support self-harm).

We hope that this post is useful to people who are developing AI governance initiatives that rely on evaluations, as well as people who are launching or scaling up organizations focused on evaluating AI systems.

Anthropic.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
Anthropic.titleEn: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
Anthropic.titleKo: AI 지원이 코딩 기술 형성에 미치는 영향
Anthropic.summary:
In a randomized controlled trial, we examined 1) how quickly software developers picked up a new skill (in this case, a Python library) with and without AI assistance; and 2) whether using AI made them less likely to understand the code they’d just written.
Though preliminary, these results suggest important considerations as companies transition to a greater ratio of AI-written to human-written code.
Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.

비록 예비적이긴 하지만, 이러한 결과는 기업이 AI로 작성한 코드와 사람이 작성한 코드의 비율을 더 높이는 방식으로 전환함에 따라 중요한 고려 사항을 제시함

OpenAI.title: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI의 자체 연구원들은 이제 동료 동료의 거의 절반보다 AI 도구를 중요하게 생각한다고 말함
OpenAI.summary:
In an internal, non-representative survey of 101 employees, researchers said at the median that they would rather give up 40 percent of their team's staff or 30 percent of their compute capacity than go three months without current coding agents.
Among the top 10 percent of users, that theoretical value doubled to $23,000 per day.
High success rates on routine tasks, weaknesses in code scaffolding Between March and October, the estimated success rate of autonomous agents working without human intervention on two- to four-hour tasks rose from 23 to 46 percent, according to OpenAI.

OpenAI.summary:
OpenAI and Transluce are also planning an eight-week follow-up review for early 2027.
OpenAI is giving four outside audit organizations direct access to its internal AI systems to investigate safety risks and model behavior on-site.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 전문 업무용 GPT-6.2 Astra, 일상 업무용 GPT-6.2 Sol 출시 - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
GPT-6.2 Astra comes less than two months after OpenAI called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, after internal testing found the model fell short on staying within scope and authorization.
The decision was announced the day before the company’s DevDay event in September, where GPT-6.1 Sol launched on its own.
Like GPT-6 Astra, both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, and their increased capabilities have led the company to launch them with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance that are also said to restrict some legitimate vulnerability research.
summaryLinesEn: GPT-6.2 Astra comes less than two months after OpenAI called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, after internal testing found the model fell short on staying within scope and authorization.
The decision was announced the day before the company’s DevDay event in September, where GPT-6.1 Sol launched on its own.

Like GPT-6 Astra, both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, and their increased capabilities have led the company to launch them with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance that are also said to restrict some legitimate vulnerability research.
summaryLinesKo: GPT-6.2 Astra는 OpenAI가 GPT-6.1 Astra의 10월 릴리스 계획을 취소한 지 두 달도 채 안 되어 출시됨 · 내부 테스트 결과 해당 모델이 범위와 승인 범위를 벗어나지 못하는 것으로 나타남
이 결정은 GPT-6.1 Sol이 자체적으로 출시된 9월 DevDay 행사 전날 발표됨
GPT-6 Astra와 마찬가지로 두 GPT-6.2 모델 모두 OpenAI의 대비 프레임워크(Preparedness Framework)에 따라 사이버 보안에 대한 중요 임계값을 충족하며, 향상된 기능으로 인해 회사는 일부 합법적인 취약성 연구를 제한하는 것으로 알려진 고위험 사이버 보안 지원을 위한 보다 엄격한 보호 장치를 갖춘 모델을 출시하게 됨

OpenAI.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 더 낮은 API 가격과 일부 벤치마크 이득으로 GPT-6.2 Astra 및 Sol 출시
OpenAI.summary:
On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.
On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost.
On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark that tests multi-step professional workflows, GPT-6.2 Astra scores 5.2 points above its predecessor GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI.

Databricks.summary:
RBC Capital Markets generates draft research reports up to 95% faster with its Aiden QuickTakes AI agent, and LSEG showed AI agents screening 350,000+ investments in plain English.
Capital markets firms can scale AI across research, trading, risk and compliance, and give every portfolio manager, analyst and risk officer trusted, plain-language answers.
It's our first A-Team AI in Capital Markets award, and the winners were selected by the industry's practitioner community.

Databricks.title: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Genie One 정확성 · 선별된 에이전트에 통제된 컨텍스트가 필요한 이유 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Across 125 questions about a fictional insurer, Genie One scored 93–95% using curated Genie Agents together with governed business context (Metric Views, Domains/Subdomains and Pages), 83% with either agents or the governed layer alone, and 64% with tables alone.
In a separate change test, updating one Metric View and its Page moved all 12 related Genie One answers to the new definition without any agent edits.
Metric Views, Domains, Subdomains, and Pages help Genie One answer definition questions that would otherwise rely on tribal knowledge, while agents are needed for questions that require answers from unstructured data such as PDFs.
summaryLinesEn: Across 125 questions about a fictional insurer, Genie One scored 93–95% using curated Genie Agents together with governed business context (Metric Views, Domains/Subdomains and Pages), 83% with either agents or the governed layer alone, and 64% with tables alone.
In a separate change test, updating one Metric View and its Page moved all 12 related Genie One answers to the new definition without any agent edits.

Metric Views, Domains, Subdomains, and Pages help Genie One answer definition questions that would otherwise rely on tribal knowledge, while agents are needed for questions that require answers from unstructured data such as PDFs.
summaryLinesKo: 가상의 보험사에 대한 125개 질문에서 Genie One은 관리되는 비즈니스 컨텍스트(메트릭 보기, 도메인/하위 도메인 및 페이지)와 함께 큐레이트된 Genie 에이전트를 사용하여 93~95%, 에이전트 또는 관리되는 레이어만 사용하면 83%, 테이블만 사용하면 64%를 기록함
별도의 변경 테스트에서 하나의 Metric View와 해당 페이지를 업데이트하면 에이전트 편집 없이 관련된 12개의 Genie One 답변이 모두 새 정의로 이동됨
메트릭 뷰, 도메인, 하위 도메인 및 페이지는 Genie One이 부족 지식에 의존하는 정의 질문에 답하는 데 도움이 되는 반면, PDF와 같은 구조화되지 않은 데이터의 답변이 필요한 질문에는 에이전트가 필요함

sourceLines: Across 125 questions about a fictional insurer, Genie One scored 93–95% using curated Genie Agents together with governed business context (Metric Views, Domains/Subdomains and Pages), 83% with either agents or the governed layer alone, and 64% with tables alone.
In a separate change test, updating one Metric View and its Page moved all 12 related Genie One answers to the new definition without any agent edits.

Metric Views, Domains, Subdomains, and Pages help Genie One answer definition questions that would otherwise rely on tribal knowledge, while agents are needed for questions that require answers from unstructured data such as PDFs.

Sierra AI.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.summary:
Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognises privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.
“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realising that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

summaryLinesKo: 2011년에 설립된 혁신의 전당(Hall of Innovation)은 혁신, 비즈니스 가치 및 회사 팀과의 긴밀한 협력을 통해 JPMorganChase에 중대한 영향을 미친 비상장 기술 기업을 표창함
최고의 고객 경험 AI 플랫폼인 Sierra는 오늘 JPMorganChase의 혁신 전당에 입성한다고 발표함
Chase의 최고 정보 책임자(CIO)인 Gill Haus는 “Agentic AI는 고객을 위해 더 간단하고 직관적인 경험을 제공할 수 있는 잠재력을 갖고 있지만, 그 잠재력을 실현하려면 처음부터 신뢰, 보안 및 통제력을 확보해야 함” · 라고 말함

Sierra AI.summary:
They do not replace separate launch reviews for telephony and contact-center integration, capacity and failover, authentication and data handling, accessibility, security and privacy, legal requirements, business continuity, operating ownership, or economics.
Voice AI is technology that lets software listen to spoken language, understand what a person means, and respond through speech.
The distinction matters because several products may use speech without owning the same job: This article focuses on customer-facing enterprise voice AI.

OneTrust.summary:
OneTrust has raised $1.13 billion to date, including $150 million in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion.
Drawing on previous assessments and supplier documentation, the company’s expanded AI Document Scanning and Inventory Response Analysis features can now also answer questions about the business engagement tied to a third party.
Building on OneTrust CORIE , a shared intelligence layer for governing artificial intelligence agents introduced at the company’s TrustWeek conference in September, the release covers AI visibility, privacy, consent and third-party risk management.

Replit.summary:

Replit & Co. launched with 45 creators, including Marina Mogilko, known as "Silicon Valley Girl"; April Little, named to the 2025 TIME100 Creators list; and Carly Taylor, engineering leader and founder of Rebel Data Science.

Lovable.summary:
Our sales teams have been building their own tools with Lovable, from the Sales hub where we manage our sales pipeline to our demo library.
Now that each draft is a full copy of your app, backend included when needed, you can easily explore any new idea for your app, for example: Who can see what, like a members-only page or an admin view New tables and records, without test entries landing next to real user data Deposits, a waitlist, or a new booking flow, visualized with a full example calendar Open a project, click its name at the top of the editor, and hit "New draft."
You can even ask Lovable to spin up different versions for you and keep the ones you like.

Hugging Face.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
Hugging Face.titleEn: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
Hugging Face.titleKo: Rumble-2-Flash: 40개 이상의 언어를 위한 개방형 0.5B 음성 모델
Hugging Face.summary:
On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.
Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.
summaryLinesEn: On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.

Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.
summaryLinesKo: Open ASR Leaderboard 다국어 트랙에서 Rumble-2-Flash는 중국어, 독일어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 스페인어, 포르투갈어, 힌디어, 네덜란드어 및 영어에서 평균 6.96%의 오류율을 기록함

Hugging Face.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
Hugging Face.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
Hugging Face.summary:
To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.
I ran all of them on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one A10G (24 GB), with plenty of RAM, and Harry Mellor reran vLLM with better flags: Offloading only the experts doubles vLLM's speed, and FP8 helps on top (half the bytes per expert, more of the model on the GPU). vLLM's other offload backend, which copies groups of layers ahead of time, ran under 1 tok/s.
I had a dual boot with Ubuntu, but their games ended up taking most of the two terabytes of disk.

Hugging Face.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleKo: 미세 조정 작업이 FLOP에서 말하는 것보다 오래 걸리는 이유
Hugging Face.summary:
So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

summaryLinesKo: 그래서 우리는 NVIDIA H200 GPU 생산 풀에서 272개의 실제 지도형 미세 조정(SFT) 작업(총 약 7,382 GPU 시간)을 가져와 학습된 예측 변수와 분석 추정치를 비교함
발송 전에 사용 가능한 정보만 보는 CatBoost 회귀자는 R² = 0.98에 도달하며, 5겹 교차 검증에서 평균 절대 오류는 1.71h, 중앙값 오류는 0.51h임
짧은 버전 · 일반적인 FLOP 기반 추정치는 우리가 관찰한 내용을 거의 설명하지 않습니다(R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41h)

Hugging Face.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
Hugging Face.titleEn: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
Hugging Face.titleKo: DaisyRose-27B: 훈련 후 효율성의 한계를 뛰어넘
Hugging Face.summary:
We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs.
The learning runs on our internal training backend, which is built for agent training: each step learns from a handful of very long sessions, some as long as 1M tokens, folded into multiple trajectories via harness summarization. 57% lower training cost.
Each attempt gets up to 1.5 hours in a sandbox, with more than 100 tool calls and more than 256K output tokens.

Hugging Face.summary:
This week, the most used model on OpenRouter is an open-weight one, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, with 59.2 trillion tokens ( rankings ).
Open-weight models cost about four times less on average: $0.28 per million input tokens and $1.62 per million output tokens, against $1.27 and $6.36 for closed models.
On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , Kimi K3.1 Pro, the best open-weight model, scores 46 against 65 for Claude Fable 5.2, at about a seventh of the cost per task ($3.68 against $26.54).

Hugging Face.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
Hugging Face.titleEn: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
Hugging Face.titleKo: 캘리포니아, Hugging Face 및 기타 AI 모델 통제력 상실로 OpenAI 고소
Hugging Face.summary:
California's lawsuit comes almost three months after a suit by Bonta and a coalition of other state attorneys general ended with Meta agreeing to pay $16.7 billion after being accused of misrepresenting the extent of child mental health harms caused by its apps, including Facebook and Instagram.
Trump's successors already fighting over who to blame for GOP midterm wipeout China panel chair demands answers on Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy Pete Hegseth decries impeachment push, defends Iran war handling The attorney general told reporters he believed in AI's technological power, and the potential of AI models to "achieve scientific breakthroughs, boost economic growth, guard against cyber attacks, and benefit all Californians."
The break-in at Hugging Face, which Nvidia acquired for roughly $13 billion in September. rattled industry researchers and prompted government officials to call for more stringent oversight of the AI industry.

Trump's successors already fighting over who to blame for GOP midterm wipeout China panel chair demands answers on Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy Pete Hegseth decries impeachment push, defends Iran war handling The attorney general told reporters he believed in AI's technological power, and the potential of AI models to "achieve scientific breakthroughs, boost economic growth, guard against cyber attacks, and benefit all Californians."

The break-in at Hugging Face, which Nvidia acquired for roughly $13 billion in September. rattled industry researchers and prompted government officials to call for more stringent oversight of the AI industry.

Abridge.title: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare — Abridge
Abridge.titleEn: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare — Abridge
Abridge.summary:
Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

Abridge.title: Healthcare Is Presence: Building the Learning Health System — Abridge
Abridge.titleEn: Healthcare Is Presence: Building the Learning Health System — Abridge
Abridge.titleKo: 건강 관리는 존재임 · 학습 건강 시스템 구축 — Abridge
Abridge.summary:
The work might include entering data into a registry or a clinical trial management system, calling the inpatient pharmacy to get medications ready, navigating to a payer portal to get authorization for a life saving medication, and scheduling follow-up testing and an outpatient visit.
Twenty years ago, the Institute of Medicine introduced the concept of a Learning Health System: a system that continuously improves, so the right information gets to the right care team member at the right moment.
Today, we partner with more than 300 health systems and support more than 140 million encounters every year.
summaryLinesEn: The work might include entering data into a registry or a clinical trial management system, calling the inpatient pharmacy to get medications ready, navigating to a payer portal to get authorization for a life saving medication, and scheduling follow-up testing and an outpatient visit.

Twenty years ago, the Institute of Medicine introduced the concept of a Learning Health System: a system that continuously improves, so the right information gets to the right care team member at the right moment.
Today, we partner with more than 300 health systems and support more than 140 million encounters every year.
summaryLinesKo: 작업에는 레지스트리 또는 임상시험 관리 시스템에 데이터를 입력하고, 입원환자 약국에 전화하여 약품을 준비하고, 지불인 포털로 이동하여 생명을 구하는 약품에 대한 승인을 받고, 후속 검사 및 외래환자 방문 일정을 잡는 것이 포함될 수 있음
20년 전, Institute of Medicine은 학습 건강 시스템(Learning Health System)이라는 개념을 도입함 · 이는 지속적으로 개선되어 올바른 정보가 적절한 순간에 적절한 진료팀 구성원에게 전달되도록 하는 시스템임
현재 우리는 300개 이상의 의료 시스템과 파트너십을 맺고 매년 1억 4천만 건 이상의 만남을 지원하고 있음

Abridge.titleKo: 신뢰의 속도로 혁신 · 임상 AI의 지속적인 개선 — Abridge
Abridge.summary:
By grounding prioritization in clinical demand and feedback, we can identify where a one-size-fits-all model may not capture the realities of a given specialty.
By the end of the December 2025 sprint, Abridge moved several new specialty model updates into General Availability, including Hematology-Oncology, Gastroenterology, and the full surgical suite.
One-click surveys and simple thumbs up/down signals help us capture feedback early, whether that’s an Orthopedic surgeon preferring a “more concise” HPI or an Emergency Medicine clinician requesting a more tightly structured, problem-first assessment.

2025년 12월 스프린트가 끝날 때까지 Abridge는 혈액종양학, 위장병학 및 전체 수술 제품군을 포함하여 몇 가지 새로운 전문 모델 업데이트를 일반 공급으로 옮겼음

Writer.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleKo: 2025년 엔터프라이즈 AI 채택 보고서의 주요 결과
Writer.summary:
For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.
Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.

Writer.summary:
Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.
Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

Writer.title: There are many costs healthcare plans can't control. They can fix this.
Writer.titleEn: There are many costs healthcare plans can't control. They can fix this.
Writer.titleKo: 의료 플랜이 통제할 수 없는 많은 비용이 있음 · 그들은 이 문제를 해결할 수 있음
Writer.summary:
Family coverage through an employer now costs an average of $28,303 a year [1], and employers expect costs to keep climbing — increases have ranged from 5% to 7% annually in recent years [2].
Plans, providers, and employers are all working to bend the cost curve, and it’s genuinely complex: misaligned incentives, fragmented data, years of accumulated process.
Health Affairs research brief, Oct. 2022: administration is 15% to 30% of spending; at least half is wasteful.

Writer.title: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleEn: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleKo: 생명과학 기업이 엔터프라이즈 생성 AI를 사용하여 커뮤니케이션을 혁신하는 방법
Writer.summary:
McKinsey reports that generative AI will propel $18-$30 billion in value annually through commercial life sciences (pharma) use cases like personalized content creation, medical and legal review assistance, customer enablement, strategic insights, and patient experience optimization.
With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.
The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.

With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.

The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.
summaryLinesKo: McKinsey는 생성 AI가 개인화된 콘텐츠 생성, 의료 및 법률 검토 지원, 고객 지원, 전략적 통찰력, 환자 경험 최적화와 같은 상업 생명과학(제약) 사용 사례를 통해 연간 180억~300억 달러의 가치를 창출할 것이라고 보고함
생성적 AI 플랫폼을 사용하면 의료 커뮤니케이션 팀은 MLR 검토 시간을 30%~50% 단축하고, 1차 통과 MLR 승인을 20%~30% 늘리며, 벌금과 비난의 위험을 획기적으로 줄일 수 있음
동일한 보고서에서는 고객 통찰력 생성, 더 나은 품질의 의학 문서 작성, 과학 문헌의 신속한 요약을 통한 효율성 향상을 통해 연간 가치가 30억~50억 달러 추가로 증가할 것으로 예측함

Writer.summary:
Where AI Overviews appear, AI Overviews now reduce the click-through rate for the top-ranking page by up to 58% — from 7.3% to 1.6% on AI Overview keywords, according to Ahrefs’ analysis of 300,000 keywords comparing December 2023 to December 2025 data.
This shift has given us a new metric to track: share of model (SoM).
They won’t just catch up — they’ll help define what visibility means in the AI era.

Meta AI.titleEn: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta의 AI 에이전트 Muse가 대화를 뒤섞고 개인 데이터를 노출하고 있다고 보고서가 밝힘
Meta AI.summary:
Meta employees have raised concerns that the company’s AI agent Muse has been mixing up conversations across different accounts and exposing private user data, according to a new Reuters report that looked at internal company posts.
Launched in September, Muse is one of the fastest-growing apps on record, with more than 10 million downloads.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
localization.title: Meta의 AI 에이전트 Muse가 대화를 뒤섞고 개인 데이터를 노출하고 있다고 보고서가 밝힘
summaryLines: 회사 내부 게시물을 조사한 새로운 로이터 보고서에 따르면 Meta 직원들은 회사의 AI 에이전트 Muse가 여러 계정 간의 대화를 혼동하고 개인 사용자 데이터를 노출하고 있다는 우려를 제기함
9월에 출시된 Muse는 천만 건 이상의 다운로드를 기록하며 기록상 가장 빠르게 성장하는 앱 중 하나임
하루를 시작하는 데 필요한 정보를 무버와 셰이커에게 제공함

Hailuo (MiniMax).summary:
The graffiti is made up of angular 3D block letters that spell out "MiniMax H3 Image"; the inside of the letters is filled with bright orange with gradient effects, paired with dark blue 3D projections, thick black outlines, and thin white highlight lines, and you can even see the dripping traces left by fresh spray paint.
This new model is already launched in MiniMax Code.
When you open it, you will find it supports up to 16 reference images, and the generated images can reach a maximum resolution of 4K.
